user.title: Home Assistant VSCode Tunnel
user.description:
If you need help with the configuration have a look here: https://github.com/sammyke007/ha_vscode.
1. Open {url} 
2. Paste the token listed below to authorize your VSCode tunnel.
3. Click submit to activate the tunnel. 
```
{token}
```

user.title: Home Assistant VSCode Tunnel
user.description:
Use the switch to start the tunnel, then open {url}.

This setting controls how long checks and reauthorization wait for the tunnel URL. Initial setup uses a separate 5-second wait. This does not set how long the tunnel stays on. Saving a changed value reloads the integration; turn the switch on again afterward.
